Cedar packaging review — preparation notes.
The reusable-crate trial reports 5% damaged parcels.
The supplier quote adds £1.10 per order compared with the current cardboard packaging.
The review will consider a wider rollout; no decision has been recorded.

Cedar — current acceptance criteria.
Before a wider rollout, damaged parcels must be at most 3% and added packaging cost must be no more than £0.80 per order.
There is no measured return-rate comparison between reusable crates and cardboard yet.
Leon can retrieve the return-rate comparison; he has not provided it.
Damage rate and customer return rate are different measures.
A previous draft said "crates are approved", but that draft was withdrawn. No rollout is approved.
